TC-21/S28.title: Nursing Home Save & Extract and Generate: time, model, and the 'generating' state while the physician moves on
TC-21/S28.detail: PW, local stack, 10 cycles, Nursing Home only, fresh residents and wording per cycle (Save & Extract answered at once, generateNote 8 s, at the socket). Each cycle: Save & Extract, Generate Note & Finish, the back arrow to the second resident and straight back (0.76–0.85 s after the press, the call still running in 10/10 cycles), Post-Round at once, then until settled. Judged against the case's 3.5 rule (TFA-92592 AC 15; the matrix tags the case U9 = TFA-92599, in progress, which is todo): the 'generating' state was shown in 0/10 cycles — Post-Round read 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' — FAILED; the note was there once the call finished in 10/10 (passed). Timings and the model per step need the live model (dev: notes.generateNote 2.8–3.2 s for Nursing Home in the gen-ac15 dev run). On 43c38a4f the note is still generated by the page: the browser calls ai/notes:generateNote, gets the text back and saves it with its own mutation (useNoteGeneration.ts finalize, snf EncounterTab.tsx handleGenerate); 'feat: use jobs for generation' (68f81eca) moved only the billing suggestion to a server job (no scheduler use for notes anywhere in convex/). Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run.
TC-21/S28.productIssue: A physician who moves to the next resident after Generate and comes back sees 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' while the note is still being written.
